messages:
lee: hi all, i'm starting today! trying to follow the onboarding quickstart: create a tiny vm in redwood-temp-eu (europe-west2) and link it to billing, but getting 'Quota exceeded: CPUS'. also my AWS assume-role returns 'AccessDenied'. who do i ping to attach billing and verify cross-account role?

ana: welcome lee :wave: check spam for the billing invite first. if accepted but still unlinked infra needs to attach the billing account. for AWS, the common issue is missing sts:AssumeRole permissions on your IAM user or an invalid trust principal. can you paste the exact gcloud + aws commands and errors?

lee: gcloud i ran:
```
gcloud compute instances create t1 --project=redwood-temp-eu --zone=europe-west2-b --machine-type=e2-medium
```
console: "Quota 'CPUS' exceeded for region europe-west2."
aws i ran:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/Redwood-Onboard --role-session-name lee-test
```
error: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole"

carlos: hey lee, welcome! infra-setup-bot can open a quota ticket and attach billing if you give project-id + billing-account-id. for the AWS part, verify your IAM user is in the onboarding group and that the onboarding account id in the trust policy matches 999888777666. i'll help check the trust policy once infra creates the ticket.

infra-setup-bot: request received: attach billing and add 8 vCPUs to project redwood-temp-eu in europe-west2. created INF-8740. ETA 3 hours (priority=high for onboarding). To attach billing manually run: `gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-temp-eu --billing-account=4444-5555-6666` once you have the billing-account-id from people-ops. For AWS assume-role: confirm your user ARN and DM the role arn to carlos to validate trust doc.

olivia: people-ops here 12: i re-sent the billing invite to your work email lee. if you don't see it, i'll attach billing after validating your manager okays the project link.

lee: got it, accepted billing invite and DM'd carlos my user arn. thanks everyone, i'll wait for INF-8740 and try again after the quota bump. will post updates here. :relieved:
